143. A ground rules hearing should discuss, as relevant:95
• The general care of the witness.
• If, when and where the witness is to be shown their video evidence.

93 CrimPR 2020, 3.9.

94 Family PD 3AA 5.2 to 5.7.

95 R v Lubemba; R v JP [2014] EWCA 2064; CPR 3.9(7).
Children, young people and vulnerable adults
Equal Treatment Bench Book – July 2024 (May 2025 update) 53
• Where, when and how the parties (and judge, if identified) will introduce themselves
to the witness.
• Any communication aids which may be needed.
• The length of questioning and frequency of breaks.
• The manner, techniques and type of questioning. See “Adjustments to
cross-examination” below for the type of adjustments which can be agreed.
• What information should be given to the jury about restrictions to cross-examination
and use of intermediaries.
